node.title: SSL Certificate Expired (update: not anymore!)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It appears the Let's Encrypt SSL Certificate on [https://www.perlmonks.org/] expired roughly two hours ago. [https://perlmonks.pairsite.com/] still works.

By the way, thanks to those who set this up!

Update: Works again, thanks [Corion]!
